caption: The drawing depicts a single kitchen utensil with a long, straight handle that appears metallic and is gray in color. The handle ends with a loop at the top, designed for hanging, and has a bulbous section near its lower end. Attached to the bottom of the handle is a circular, flat disc that is golden-yellow in color with a metallic sheen. The disc features a series of regularly spaced holes arranged in a symmetrical, radial pattern, with several concentric rings and star-like lines formed by the placement of the perforations. Three round fasteners or rivets, also gold in color, are visible near the center and upper part of the disc, securing it to the handle. In the upper right section of the drawing, there is a smaller, less detailed line sketch of the same object, showing its form and proportions in outline. A simple horizontal scale marked "6 in." is drawn in the lower left corner of the page. The artist's name, "H.A. Marsh," is signed in the bottom right corner. The background is plain and light beige.
title: Skimmer
